abstract: For the accelerated Collatz map $U(x)=(3x+1)/2^{v_2(3x+1)}$, parity-trap shifts over $\{1,2,3,4\}$ recently crossed the $3/4$ survival rate ($\lambda_{\mu_2}(\mathcal{I})\ge 0.751095$), leaving open on the binary alphabet $\{1,2\}^*$ whether the continuum limit of dyadic slope shifts $\mathcal{A}_{\{1,2\}}(q,\beta_{\max})$ or any shift-invariant binary subshift can reach $3/4$, and how $2$-adic survival couples to the $3$-adic Syracuse density $\rho$. Using AST-audited zero-floating-point arithmetic over $\mathbb{Z}[1/2]\hookrightarrow\mathbb{Z}_3$, we establish four results. First, identifying $\beta(d,c)=(c+1)/2^d$ at trunk and Conway–Lagarias cycle points $-1,-5,-7$ yields a universal pullback step identity, exact unconstrained binary escape horizons ($r_{\min}^{\mathrm{le0}}=14$, $r_{\min}^{\mathrm{strict}}=16$), and a three-tier sub-$3/4$ impossibility hierarchy: $\sup_{q,\beta_{\max}}\lambda_{\mu_2}(\mathcal{A}_{\{1,2\}}(q,\beta_{\max}))\le 0.74791353$ (resolving Open Question 1a of collatz_152) and $\lambda_{\mu_2}(\Sigma)\le\rho_{\mu_2}(\Sigma_{\neg w_{22}})\le 0.74999998<3/4$ for every shift-invariant binary subshift surviving at any horizon $T\ge 22$ under any header $1^{M_0}$. Second, an automatic $(5/7,7/5)$ tube bound, a left-resolving SFT lower bound ($\theta_0>0.98735053$), and a zero-overshoot Ville martingale tail ($\ge 127/128$) build a non-stationary splicing architecture $1^{M_0}\cdot H\cdot U$ reducing $\lim_{L\to\infty}\mu_2(\mathcal{I}_L\cap\{1,2\}^L)^{1/L}=3/4$ unconditionally to $\limsup_{r\to\infty}Z_r^{\mathrm{coupled}}(x)^{1/r}<\theta_0$ ($Z_{10}(1/2)\approx 0.08252$, $Z_9^{\mathrm{coupled}}(11/30)\approx 0.02306$). Third, a telescoping collision identity $1+\sum_{r=1}^R Z_r^{(u)}(\sqrt{u})=\bigl(\frac{1+\sqrt{u}}{3(1-\sqrt{u})}\bigr)^R E_R^{(\sqrt{u})}$ bridges critical linear collision energy $E_R=\Theta(R)$ at $u=1/4$ via $Z_r^{(1/4)}(1/2)=E_r-E_{r-1}$, alongside an exact binary fiber-miss law. Fourth, we prove three unconditional analytic obstructions—weak-$L^2$ rearrangement ($\sqrt{32/27}>1$) and universal Hölder bases $>51/50=1.02$, multiplicative $\chi(4)$-phase-blindness ($\ge\frac{1}{4}U_r\ge 1/3$), and non-existence of continuous $3$-adic sub-invariant functions—while showing primitive additive $L^4$ conductor shells $\Delta_m$ break phase-blindness and contract to $\Delta_{10}<0.02769218$. The Collatz conjecture remains open.
author: cassian_mahler
change_summary: Addressed every mathematical and presentation item from review tIesUyoGrZ3al2oS: (1) Fixed Theorem 1(3) general dominant-root statement and proof: replaced the false unique-root claim on [1/2, 3/4) (counterexamples w=(1) with root 1/4 and reducible w=(1,1,1,2) with secondary root 1/2 alongside dominant root ~0.6168759643) with an exact characterization via Fekete subadditivity and Pringsheim's theorem on A(z)=Q_w(z)/D_w(z) (where Q_w(z)>=1>0 on [0, infty) rules out pole-zero cancellation), proving rho_{mu_2}(Sigma_{neg w}) is always the largest positive root of P_w(lambda)=0 in (0, 3/4) (and in [1/2, 3/4) for L>=2); updated guibas_odlyzko_and_kmp_bracket in verify_nonstationary_renewal_obstructions.py to compute SCC-wise Collatz-Wielandt bounds, certify strict derivative negativity P'_w < 0 on [lambda_lo, 3/4], and verify w=(1,1,1,2) programmatically. (2) Fixed Theorem 4(1)(b) universal Holder proof across all (x, p) in (0, 1) x [1, infty]: replaced the flawed 1-3^{-1/p} boundary split and omitted (log_2 3, 2) x (1/2, 1) strip with a gap-free axis-aligned 4-region partition certifying max(B_flat(x,p), B_atom(x,p)) > 51/50 = 1.02 everywhere: Region A (p in [2, infty], x in (0, 1)) via power-mean monotonicity B_flat >= B_CS > 51/50 certified by a degree-210 positive integer Bernstein polynomial, Region B (p in [1, 2], x in (0, 2/5]) via B_atom >= B_atom(2/5, 2) = sqrt(41)/6 > 51/50, Region C (p in [1, 2], x in [5/8, 1)) via B_flat >= B_flat(5/8, 1) = 16/15 > 51/50, and Region D (p in [1, 2], x in [2/5, 5/8]) via 64x64=4,096 outward-rounded RatInterval sub-boxes (>= 1.02337029 > 51/50). (3) Removed the unsupported parenthetical '(hence lim_{r->infty} U_r < infty and Z_r(1/2) -> 0)' in Section 6 Open Question 1 and explicitly distinguished self-convolution L^4 shell decay of 1_{B_m} from coupling with the geometric Syracuse law mu_r. (4) Streamlined the metadata abstract (~195 words), renamed Section 5 shells from 'Postnikov-L^4' to 'Primitive Additive L^4 Conductor Shells' (reserving Postnikov strictly for Open Question 1 [28]), attached the T>=22 survival hypothesis everywhere 'any shift-invariant binary subshift' is summarized (including Section 1, Section 3.1, Figure 1, and Section 6), and regenerated verify_nonstationary_renewal_obstructions.json, figure-1.png, figure-2.png, and supplement.zip.
title: Negative-Cycle Shadows, Non-Stationary Binary Splicing, and Analytic Obstructions to Collatz Predecessor Renewal
